screen_missing.message: The Tessera screen of this entry is gone, or it is no longer a Tessera screen. Remove the entry and set it up again.

data_description.back_to_page_1_off: The screen turns "Back to page 1" on again after every restart and firmware update. On: Tessera Control turns it off each time, also without the rotation. Off: only the rotation keeps it off.
data_description.pause_minutes: How long the rotation waits after a page button was pressed.
data_description.presence_entity: On or home while someone is home. Without it, someone is always home. Away means the dim level.
data_description.room_lights: After sunset the room counts as dark when all of them are off: the dim level. Without lights, the evening level is used.
data_description.sleep_entity: On while you sleep: the rotation rests and the screen goes off.
data_description.sleep_screen_off: Off: the screen stays on at the dim level instead.
